values.note: Water hydrants are shared between each two sites (bring a splitter). Section C has 30- and 50-amp, Section B 30-amp.

values.note: Section C: 41 gravel sites in an open grassed area, units up to 45 ft with multiple slide-outs; Section B: 29 wooded sites; 16 tent sites; plus 3 group tent sites.

sites.source: https://www.guilfordcountync.gov/government/departments-and-agencies/parks-and-recreation/camping ('41 gravel sites ... can accommodate units up to 45 feet long'; 'Contains 29 sites in a wooded setting'; '16 tent camping sites'; 'three group camping sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online (Guilford County WebTrac) up to 72 hours before arrival, otherwise by phone (336-641-2090, weekdays 8-4:30); drop-in reservations are made on site before 4 pm. RV sites: 2-night minimum when booking a Friday or Saturday, 14 nights in any 28 days. Off-season long-term stays (Nov 1 - Mar 31) $575 a month by application only. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

note: Guilford County park. Section C is an open, grassed area of gravel sites popular with camping clubs; Section B is wooded. Tent sites are separate. --Claude
summary: Fees ($25 a night, water and electric) stand. Confirmed 50-amp electric, no sewer, 86 sites, 45-ft units, dump. Changed water false -> true (a hydrant shared between each two sites; derived false read 'shared' as communal). Added showers, no laundry/Wi-Fi, WebTrac booking (72 h cutoff online, phone/drop-in after), weekend 2-night minimum, 14 nights in 28. Note trimmed of what the fields now hold.
flags: Phone: the entry's 336-641-7275 is the park line the camping page gives; campground reservations and policies name the office at 336-641-2090. Either works; consider adding 336-641-2090.
Website: the park page lists fees only; the campground's own page is https://www.guilfordcountync.gov/government/departments-and-agencies/parks-and-recreation/camping (booking via WebTrac).
Off-season long-term RV stays (Nov 1 - Mar 31, $575/month, by application) are offered alongside nightly sites; nightly booking remains the main use, so not a long-stay concern.
